_comment: Manually-maintained homepage values that are NOT part of the automated daily pipeline. Edit these by hand. nreFd = best NRE fixed-deposit rate shown in the sidebar (update from bank websites). bulletinReleases = known/estimated U.S. State Dept Visa Bulletin publication dates (ISO, ET); the sidebar shows days until the next one after today. The Visa Bulletin for a given month is published in the second week of the PRIOR month. IMPORTANT: visaBulletinState() treats any PAST date here as proof that the corresponding bulletin was published — so a date that slips by without a release makes the homepage ticker and immigration tracker assert a bulletin is out when it isn't. If a release date passes with no bulletin on travel.state.gov, push that entry forward to the next plausible business day rather than leaving it in the past. Err LATE, never early: a too-early date states a falsehood, a too-late one only understates freshness.
